paper_title: A Unified Algorithm for Stochastic Path Problems
authors: Christoph Dann, Chen-Yu Wei, Julian Zimmert
statement: Finally, it remains an open question to prove or disprove Zhang et al. (2021)’s conjecture about the lower-order term, which has direct consequences for our adaptivity result in SLP.
context: In general SP when B⋆ is unknown, can we achieve the bound of order Õ(Rmax poly(S, A)K), √ any constant term that scales super-linearly with Rmax ? This would be analogous to the without Õ(B⋆ S 2 AK) bound we get for SLP, but our technique there does not lead to this desired bound. Finally, it remains an open question to prove or disprove Zhang et al. (2021)’s conjecture about the lower-order term, which has direct consequences for our adaptivity result in SLP.
